ios.desc:
Build an adaptive running plan around your life—and bring every workout to Apple Watch. Kiiro combines flexible training plans, run tracking, and detailed Apple Watch data in one place.

AN ADAPTIVE RUNNING PLAN

Tell Kiiro about your running experience, available days, weekly training time, and preferred long-run days. Kiiro builds a plan around your schedule and keeps the weeks ahead aligned with the training you actually complete.

• Easy runs, long runs, intervals, warmups, and cooldowns
• Duration and heart-rate targets for structured sessions
• A choice of progression styles, from patient to ambitious
• Plan alignment and training-load guidance after every run

MADE FOR APPLE WATCH RUNNERS

Send scheduled runs to the Workout app on Apple Watch and follow each structured session from your wrist. Record your workout as usual, then let Kiiro sync and analyze the result.

• Keep upcoming workouts on Apple Watch
• Compare your completed run with the planned target
• Automatically connect recorded runs to your training plan
• See your schedule, workout details, and progress on iPhone


FLEXIBLE WHEN LIFE CHANGES

Missed a day or need to move a run? Reschedule the current or next week and Kiiro rebuilds it around the days that still work. Change your availability, weekly time, frequency, long-run preference, or progression style whenever your routine changes.

DETAILED RUN TRACKING AND ANALYSIS

Go beyond a basic distance tracker. Kiiro turns Apple Watch workout data into a clear picture of each run and your longer-term progress.

• Explore route maps, splits, pace, distance, duration, elevation, and energy
• Review heart rate, zones, cadence, power, stride length, vertical oscillation, and ground contact time when recorded
• Move between summary, performance, and history views for each workout
• Compare every attempt on the same route to see where you improved
• Edit workout details or merge sessions when a workout was recorded in separate parts

UNDERSTAND YOUR TRAINING OVER TIME

Kiiro brings individual workouts and long-term trends together, so your Apple Watch data becomes useful guidance instead of a collection of numbers.

• Training Load shows your recent effort and short-term fatigue
• Fitness Level follows the longer-term training base you are building
• Load Balance helps show whether you are fresh, building, balanced, fatigued, or pushing too hard
• Running Score lets you compare performance across intervals, long runs, and recovery runs
• Follo

quotes.text:
Building Kiiro — training analytics for Apple Watch runners.

Got frustrated with Apple's Fitness app being too basic and third-party apps creating anxiety with made-up "recovery scores." Wanted something in between: proper training load tracking without the daily judgment.

Uses 42-day EWMA for chronic load, 7-day for acute. HR-based rather than rTSS since most people don't know their lactate threshold. Zone breakdowns, route comparisons, the stuff that actually helps you see if your training is working.

Free, no ads: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6749277384

Would love feedback from anyone who trains with an Apple Watch.
